title: Quantitative Identification of Major Depression Based on Resting-State Dynamic Functional Connectivity: A Machine Learning Approach
summary: A nonlinear SVM distinguished major-depression cases from healthy controls using dynamic functional-connectivity features in 99 participants, with AUC 0.9913 versus 0.8685 using static connectivity. This is a small retrospective classification result, not independent clinical validation.
